$comment: Racing liveries for the hero car, to replace `LIVERIES` in apps/coast/src/render/procgen.ts.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. That table ships `gulf` and `martini`. Those are not colour schemes, they
are the trademarks of two companies — a fuel brand and a drinks brand — and they are the single
most recognisable thing about the cars that wore them. A roofline can be made original by
describing an era instead of a car, which is what assets.json does; a livery cannot, because it
IS the identifying mark and nothing else about it is load-bearing. `rosso` and `midnight` are
fine as they stand: a red racing car and a dark blue one are national racing colours, not
anyone's property.
WHAT MAKES ONE OF THESE READ AS PERIOD without borrowing a mark:
- Two colours and at most one accent. Multi-colour gradient schemes are a 1980s habit.
- The stripe runs fore-and-aft over the nose and roof, or as a broad band around the middle.
Diagonal flashes and swooshes are later.
- The number lives in a plain circle or a rectangle on the door, in a period grotesque.
- Colours are mixed paint, not metallics: a period car is flat, saturated and slightly off.
AND WHAT TO AVOID, because the failure mode here is arriving back at the thing you meant to
leave: pale blue with an orange stripe is one company's mark, and white with a dark blue and red
double stripe is another's. Neither pairing appears below, and neither should be reintroduced
because it 'looks right' — looking right is exactly what makes it theirs.
PROMOTING THIS is a paste into procgen.ts: the shape is already `Livery` — body, stripe, number.
The hero mesh is generated in plain off-white (see assets.json, hero-prototype `paint`) so the
tint reads true whichever of these is applied.

liveries.name: Salt flat
liveries.reads: A works white with a single deep maroon centre stripe. The plainest of the set and the one that best carries a number.

liveries.name: Kingfisher
liveries.reads: Deep marine blue with a cream stripe — the dark-blue-and-cream pairing an entrant used before sponsors bought the bodywork.

liveries.name: Sandline
liveries.reads: Bone with oxide red. Reads as a privateer who painted over last season's colours, which is what most of the field was.

liveries.name: Sunstrip
liveries.reads: Ochre with a near-black stripe. The loudest one, and the one that reads at sprite size against a blue sea.

liveries.name: Rosso
liveries.reads: Kept from the existing table. A red racing car is a national colour, not a mark.

liveries.name: Midnight
liveries.reads: Kept from the existing table. Near-black with a gold stripe, which belongs to nobody.

retire.why: Pale blue with an orange stripe is a fuel company's registered livery.
White with the blue-and-red double stripe is a drinks company's registered livery.
